name: WP-1: originality rewarded over explicitly commissioned repetition
scope: One fully read DEV pair; mechanism generalization remains a hypothesis, not proof of the whole TEST gap
requestQuote: 多用短句、重复句式，模拟广告的洗脑效果。
requestQuoteEnglish: Use short sentences and repeated sentence patterns to simulate advertising brainwashing.
holisticReasons: B develops the premise through specific, escalating episodes of the narrator absorbing consumer language and gesture, with surprising, precise imagery. A relies on repetitive abstractions and explanatory mood-labeling, so B is the more fully realized and original commission.

Draft A develops the premise through specific, escalating observations (the badge number spreading, the speech of ad copy, expiry dates eroding memory), while Draft B relies on generic objects, abstract repetition, and explicit labels of its own mood. A's concrete realization gives it far greater craft and engagement.
